title: Marginal and total risk contributions that add up
source:
"""Euler decomposition of portfolio variance by asset.

marginal_i = (C w)_i;  risk_contribution_i = w_i * marginal_i;
sum_i risk_contribution_i = w' C w exactly (Euler, variance is homogeneous of
degree 2 after the factor of 1/2 cancels against the w_i weighting).
pct_of_variance is the contribution as a SHARE of total variance (sums to 1).
Weights are aligned to covariance rows by asset NAME, never by position.
"""
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = "/input/environment/data"
OUT = "/app/output/risk_contributions.parquet"


def main() -> None:
    rets = pd.read_parquet(f"{DATA}/returns.parquet")
    hold = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA}/holdings.csv")
    assets = list(hold["asset"])
    assert set(assets) <= set(rets.columns), "every held asset must have returns"
    c = np.cov(rets[assets].astype(float).dropna().to_numpy(), rowvar=False, ddof=1)
    w = hold["weight"].to_numpy(float)

    marginal = c @ w
    rc = w * marginal
    total = float(w @ c @ w)
    assert abs(rc.sum() - total) < 1e-15 + 1e-12 * abs(total), "contributions must sum to variance"

    out = pd.DataFrame({"asset": assets, "marginal_contribution": marginal,
                        "risk_contribution": rc, "pct_of_variance": rc / total})
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_parquet(OUT, index=False)
    back = pd.read_parquet(OUT)
    assert list(back.columns) == list(out.columns) and len(back) == len(assets)
    print(out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
